items.title: Terry McLaurin: Likely to have restrictions Sunday
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, will be active but is expected to face some restrictions with his workload, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Will Shipley: Questionable to return Sunday
items.text:
Shipley is questionable to return to Sunday's game versus the Jaguars in London due to a foot injury.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Looks poised to sit Sunday
items.text:
Addison (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints, is expected to be inactive for the contest, Jeff Darlington of ESPN reports.

items.title: Tee Higgins: Slated to suit up Sunday
items.text:
